description: Light horizontal product-style motion piece with a gradient orb, floating food cards, feature rows and a mobile interface; despite its filename, sampled frames contain no tutorial UI.

techniques.name: Floating feature-card choreography
techniques.evidence: Food-card clusters become evenly spaced feature rows, then expand into a photo grid.
implementation: Create original cards from local data/assets.
Stagger entries into a stable grid.
Use a small scale/position change to suggest depth.
Keep the viewport clear rather than copying branded UI.

techniques.name: Product interface focus
techniques.evidence: A phone interface takes over the central composition after the feature sequence.
implementation: Introduce one product frame with a short eased entrance.
Keep supporting labels readable and motion restrained.

typography: Sparse product labels, rounded UI rows and compact interface typography.
composition: Wide light canvas, layered card clusters, large negative space and a later centered phone.
effects: Card grouping/spreading, UI transitions, gentle scale and spatial repositioning.
easing: Exact source interpolation is uncertain. Any stored guidance is an original cubic-ease design recommendation, not a recovered curve.
uncertainties: Exact font family and original keyframe/easing parameters are not recoverable from these sampled frames.
Intervals are approximate observations, not audio-aligned or frame-precise annotations.
reviewer: Codex visual review of sampled source frames
